creature_text.Text: Welcome, Huo. The people have missed your warmth.
There is a much larger problem we face now, my students. Shen-zin Su is in pain. If we do not act, the very land on which we stand could die, and all of us with it.
Hey there! Are you the one that brought back the fire spirit?
Of course he was hot! Don't be dumb, Deng.
Nuh uh. Bet they could for sure kick you over that hill, though! Hah!
Okay bye.
Was he hot?  I bet he was hot!
I bet you're really strong, huh?  You could probably kick that bridge right in half if you wanted to!
Bye!
Hey $p! This way to Morning Breeze Village.
Let's tackle this one together!
Wait!
Wait for another opening. I'll meet you on the far side.
Come child. We have one final journey to take together before your training is complete.
For 3,000 years, we have passed the knowledge of our people down. Elder to youth. Master to student.
$p, our people have lived the wholes of their lives on this great turtle, Shen-zin Su, but not in hundreds of years has anyone spoken to him.
Now Shen-zin Su is ill, and we are all in danger. With the help of the elements, you will break the silence. You will speak to him.
Aysa and Ji have retrieved the spirits and brought them here. You are to go with them, speak to the great Shen-zin Su, and do what must be done to save our people.
You've come far, my young student. I see within you a great hero. I leave the fate of this land to you.
$p, where's Master Shang?
Bah, let a pandaren hope, would you?  I'm going to miss the old man.
When am I not respectful?  You hurt me, Aysa.
A thorn?  And I left my tweezers at home.
How could such a thing cause pain to something so large?
Are you seeing what I'm seeing?!  Is that a boat?!
And those aren't pandaren down there.  They've got no fur.
...Ji, they were in the Wood of Staves.  You know where Master Shang is now.
Ji, be respectful when we speak to Shen-zin Su.
I might if you embarrass us.
Shen-zin Su, we are the descendants of Liu Lang.  We've sensed your pain, and we want to help.
What ails you Shen-zin Su?  What can we do?
Of course, Shen-zin Su!  But your shell is large, and I do not know where this thorn could be.
We will find it, and we will remove it.  You have our word!
We'll know soon enough.
It is a boat... a whole airship!  That's a bigger thorn than I was expecting.
Someone has crashed into our island.  Removing this thorn may be more complicated than we thought.
We should let Elder Shaopai know and then plan our next move.
I am in pain, but it warms my heart that Liu Lang's grandchildren have not forgotten me.
There is a thorn in my side.  I cannot remove it.
The pain is unbearable, and I can no longer swim straight.
Please grandchildren, can you remove this thorn?  I cannot do so on my own.
It is in the forest where your feet do not walk.  Continue along the mountains and you will find it.
Thank you, grandchildren.
$n's here. Let's go.
Wha...
The gate is jammed.
Let me try.
Did they prop this door up against a boulder?  It won't budge!
Well done, Jojo!
Let's go find this engineer.  Maybe getting this thorn removed won't be as hard as we thought.
Ji may kill Shen-zin Su if we let him go through with this! Come with me, $p, quickly!
Ji, stop! This is reckless and stupid.
If you stop this, then maybe we can come up with one.
Doing THIS risks everything!
Ji... if this is what you must do, I will not stop you, but we could lose everything. I hope you're right.
Aysa sighs.
Aysa, this is our only option. We blow the ship free, then we heal his wound. We have no other solution.
So we just wait until we think of something? Shen-zin Su is dying! Doing nothing risks everything!
I'd rather die knowing that at least we tried.
I'm... alive?  Thank you... thank you so much!
Thank you for the timely rescue, hero.
I owe you my life.
